roadmap_reconciliation.replacement_for_CA7_6_contract: MANUAL/TICKET pending proposals use owner-version stale rejection; AUTO has no pending proposal and is governed by shared owner-lock/CAS serialization.
basis: AutoResult comment and service implementation explicitly no pending AUTO proposal

rows.title: Authority/candidate binding
rows.must_prove: Bind Pass594 PassMap/backend/current src_64/v1.164 exact hashes; no newer archive promoted by filename.

rows.title: Typed appearance contribution identity
rows.must_prove: Hero/Pet contributions carry owner instance, current table, origin family, exact content revision, effective appearance owner state_version and captured observedAt; validation rejects mismatched/invalid identities.

rows.title: Caller-owned read seam
rows.must_prove: Contribution readers require caller tx.Queryer + exact revision + caller observedAt; no ActiveRevision lookup, tx.Runner, write, lock, receipt, I5 call, live clock, scheduler or battle/mode policy.

rows.title: Hero kind provenance
rows.must_prove: Hero reader resolves HeroKind from immutable CreationContentRevision before effective projection; current exact appearance revision is used for skin/LIVE qualification.

rows.title: Operation-time qualification/freeze
rows.must_prove: Before/at/after timed expiry qualification follows accepted CA7 boundary; one supplied observedAt is used; a returned contribution remains unchanged if durable entitlement later expires/mutates.

rows.title: Raw/effective selector separation
rows.must_prove: Stale/unqualified ordinary selector projects 0; stale explicit illusion projects inherit/default -1; durable raw state is not rewritten by read contribution.

rows.title: Hero presentation/combat isolation
rows.must_prove: Current source oracle proves illusion-aware presentation and ordinary-skin combat-skill axes remain distinct; CA7 contribution does not collapse them into one battle model or derive illusion skin-skill.

rows.title: Dynamic-card/LIVE boundary
rows.must_prove: MID68/69 qualified paid LIVE remains Character appearance state; current tree has no battle consumer; CA7 contribution carries qualified LIVE but does not invent combat stat/skill semantics. Deterministic model order retained.

rows.title: Pet home-style boundary
rows.must_prove: MID1893/1894/1895 effective Pet style contribution is family-qualified and deterministic; current Pet combat/model paths do not use active_style. Historical current-tree PetAttributeWindow0 MID60/61 branch stays fenced as unreachable retained source.

rows.title: CA6 Hero MANUAL/TICKET invalidation
rows.must_prove: Create real pending Hero MANUAL or TICKET proposal, perform actual state-changing CA7 Hero mutation, then SAVE rejects owner-version stale before apply/delete.

rows.title: CA6 Pet MANUAL/TICKET invalidation
rows.must_prove: Create real pending Pet MANUAL or TICKET proposal, perform actual state-changing CA7 Pet mutation, then SAVE rejects owner-version stale before apply/delete.

rows.title: CA7 semantic no-op preservation
rows.must_prove: Real Hero/Pet CA7 semantic no-op does not advance owner state_version and does not invalidate an otherwise valid pending MANUAL/TICKET proposal.

rows.title: Stale TICKET accounting
rows.must_prove: Ticket consumed at proposal generation remains consumed; stale SAVE after CA7 mutation performs no second debit, no refund, and leaves stale proposal present.

rows.title: CA6 AUTO reconciliation
rows.must_prove: Do not fabricate an AUTO proposal. Prove from accepted application code/tests that CA7 mutations and CA6 AUTO compose through the same Hero410/Pet430 owner-lock and owner-CAS seams; locally prove deterministic serialized-order state transitions in a harness. Do not claim real concurrent PostgreSQL row-lock behavior; that remains CA7-7.

rows.title: Hero/Pet core preservation
rows.must_prove: Real unrelated Hero/Pet core/progression mutations preserve CA7 selectors/entitlement child state; real CA7 mutations preserve identity/progression/show/skills fields.

rows.title: Equipment/Fumo preservation
rows.must_prove: Real CA4 Hero/Pet mutation preserves CA7 durable state; real CA7 mutation preserves equipment/Fumo; owner revision advances only for actual mutation.

rows.title: Saved-reference preservation
rows.must_prove: CA7 mutation does not rewrite saved-preset root/lane/reference authority; CA5 mutation does not rewrite CA7 owner/child appearance state.

rows.title: Commerce materializer boundary
rows.must_prove: Preserve the already-accepted Character-side TxPermanentSkinMaterializer contract: caller owns transaction/retry/receipt and future Commerce settlement; Character alone validates/grants entitlement and advances Hero owner CAS. CA7-6 adds no second materializer and no foreign-owner SQL. No future Commerce business implementation is required here.

rows.title: LibraryPresentation boundary
rows.must_prove: Current MID835 board_partner/board_card/board_model_id remain separate Library/I9N persistence/policy facts. CA7 contribution exposes only qualified Hero appearance provenance/state; it does not own board_* fields, derive a universal board-card formula, or implement I9N policy.

rows.title: Tree-wide current source oracle
rows.must_prove: All eight CA7 appearance MIDs and bounded consumers are checked against the full 4,370-file current tree; source-member hashes match oracle; PetAttributeWindow0 reachability and v1.164 battle differential are explicit.

rows.title: Reload/reconnect and deterministic projection
rows.must_prove: Existing stock reload plus new contribution readers rebuild effective state from keyed durable authority at exact revision/observedAt; sorted skin/LIVE/style projections remain deterministic and client projection arrays are never ingested as authority.

rows.title: No new owner/schema/scheduler
rows.must_prove: No migration, Cosmetics aggregate, foreign-owner SQL, per-player expiry scheduler, CA8 aggregate implementation, new gameplay MID, or new receipt family is introduced by CA7-6.

rows.title: Residual Character obligations
rows.must_prove: Stone/capacity/stat-crosswalk/Spirit and unresolved Rune/rep-lock obligations remain routed to CA8/CAE/future provider work rather than misclassified as appearance implementation.

rows.title: Named deferred proof remains deferred
rows.must_prove: CA7-7 exact/native accumulated PostgreSQL/River proof and W2 physical unmodified-stock-client proof are not marked passed by CA7-6 local evidence.

rows.title: Independent pre/post reality check
rows.must_prove: Before implementation: independently reread Pass594 authority, accepted CA7-1/CA6 contracts, current/v1.164 source and backend seams; attempt to falsify every R2 research decision. After implementation: independently inspect produced code and map every frozen acceptance row.

local_acceptance_rule: Every LOCAL_REQUIRED row must be evidenced GREEN or explicitly ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED only where the frozen contract names a later gate. A test passing in a compatibility copy does not satisfy exact-native CA7-7/W2 proof.
implementation_scope_guard: CA7-6 implementation, if later authorized, is expected to be contribution/read seam + integration/architecture/source-oracle proof. New schema/MIDs/receipt families/owners are presumptively out of scope and require research reopening.
